segments.name: New
segments.meaning: Customers who placed their first order recently.
segments.suggested_next_step: Welcome the customer and help them get a successful first experience.

segments.name: Best customers
segments.meaning: Customers who buy recently, frequently, and with high value.
segments.suggested_next_step: Recognize their value and maintain a proactive account relationship.

segments.name: Loyal
segments.meaning: Customers who buy regularly and recently.
segments.suggested_next_step: Keep the relationship active with relevant service and offers.

segments.name: At risk
segments.meaning: Customers who used to buy often but have gone quiet.
segments.suggested_next_step: Review the account history and contact the customer to understand what changed.

segments.name: Lost
segments.meaning: Customers who have been quiet for a long time and never bought often.
segments.suggested_next_step: Choose carefully between a low-cost reactivation attempt and closing the account.

segments.name: Occasional
segments.meaning: Customers who do not fit a more specific segment.
segments.suggested_next_step: Look for useful purchase patterns and encourage repeat buying where relevant.
